protocol.blocking_selection: fastest complete tuning median among all on-time 1.25x-qualified configurations
protocol.baseline_selection: fastest complete tuning median among all on-time 1.25x-qualified configurations
protocol.tuning_guard_note: 95% empirical tuning guard, not a population-success certificate
protocol.posting_compression: CL/Intersection: unique (fingerprint,parent); FH: one lowest parent ID per fingerprint
protocol.feasibility_scope: per-job >=90% held-out on-time 1.25x success under each of four hard budgets; bounded max8 search only
protocol.selection: fastest complete tuning median among all on-time 1.25x-qualified configurations
protocol.search_scope: family_specs short list; delta={64,128,256}; L={1,2,3,4,5,6,8}; max8; BOTH CL and FH
protocol.infeasibility_scope: no qualifying configuration in this bounded search is not global approximate infeasibility
protocol.ratio_conditioning: only finite-distance answers returned within the query deadline; missing/late ratios are null
protocol.tolerance: positive optimum: distance <= factor*optimum + 1e-8; zero optimum: distance == 0
protocol.timing: CL and Intersection include exact candidate verification; FH stops before offline returned-distance evaluation
protocol.serving_memory: actual table arrays, actual stored/probed order families, shifts and masks; raw curves and scratch excluded
protocol.tuning_prefix_policy: shared prefix views project selected-L storage; final selections rebuilt at exactly L
protocol.construction_guard: uint32 per-table offsets, signed int32 parent IDs, conservative 48GB raw construction estimate, 1800s alarm before allocation
protocol.build_timeout_caveat: SIGALRM is armed before allocation; native kernels may return before Python delivers the timeout
